title: Server/Technology Version Disclosure via HTTP Headers (65.61.137.117:443)
description: HTTP response headers reveal technology details: Server: Server: Apache-Coyote/1.1; . Disclosed version information aids attackers in selecting targeted exploits.
recommendation: Suppress or genericize Server, X-Powered-By, X-Generator, X-AspNet-Version headers. Use ServerTokens Prod (Apache) or server_tokens off (Nginx).

title: Session Cookie Missing SameSite Attribute (65.61.137.117:443)
description: Cookies missing SameSite: JSESSIONID; . Without SameSite, cookies are sent in cross-site requests, enabling CSRF attacks.
recommendation: Set SameSite=Lax (default recommended) or SameSite=Strict for all session cookies. Use SameSite=None only for intentionally cross-site cookies.

title: Session Cookies Not Using __Host- or __Secure- Prefix (65.61.137.117:443)
description: Session cookies JSESSIONID;  do not use the __Host- or __Secure- cookie prefix. These prefixes enforce Secure, Path=/, and no Domain attribute, preventing subdomain cookie injection.
recommendation: Rename session cookies to use __Host- prefix (strictest) or __Secure- prefix for better security boundaries.

title: No Account Lockout on Login Page (65.61.137.117:443)
description: Login endpoint https://65.61.137.117:443/login did not trigger lockout or rate limiting after 6 consecutive failed attempts. This enables brute-force attacks.
recommendation: Implement account lockout after N failed attempts (5-10 recommended). Add CAPTCHA after initial failures. Implement progressive delays. Log and alert on repeated failures from same IP.

title: Login Page Detected (65.61.137.117:443)
description: Login/admin pages found at https://65.61.137.117:443: /admin/login(302) /admin(302) . These should be assessed for credential strength, MFA enforcement, and brute-force protections.
recommendation: Require MFA for all privileged accounts. Implement account lockout and CAPTCHA. Restrict admin login to internal networks or VPN where possible.

title: Clickjacking Protection Missing — No X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors (65.61.137.117:443)
description: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors is set at https://65.61.137.117:443. The page can be framed by any domain, enabling clickjacking attacks.
recommendation: Add Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self'; (preferred) or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN. CSP frame-ancestors takes precedence over X-Frame-Options in modern browsers.
